description: Source code for Bluetooth ISO connected benchmark sample using Zephyr RTOS, implementing central and peripheral roles, handling ISO channels, CIG creation, and data transmission.

methods.name: device_role_select
methods.description: Prompts user to select device role: central, peripheral, or quit.

methods.name: print_stats
methods.description: Prints received and lost packet statistics.

methods.name: iso_send
methods.description: Sends ISO data over a specified channel.

methods.name: iso_timer_timeout
methods.description: Timer callback to trigger ISO data transmission.

methods.name: iso_sent
methods.description: Callback after ISO data is sent, reschedules transmission.

methods.name: scan_recv
methods.description: Processes received scan results to find target device.

methods.name: get_chars
methods.description: Reads user input characters from console.

methods.name: parse_rtn_arg
methods.description: Parses RTN argument from user input.

methods.name: parse_interval_arg
methods.description: Parses interval argument from user input.

methods.name: parse_latency_arg
methods.description: Parses latency argument from user input.

methods.name: parse_phy_arg
methods.description: Parses PHY argument from user input.

methods.name: parse_sdu_arg
methods.description: Parses SDU size argument from user input.

methods.name: parse_c_to_p_ft_arg
methods.description: Parses central to peripheral flush timeout.

methods.name: parse_p_to_c_ft_arg
methods.description: Parses peripheral to central flush timeout.

methods.name: change_central_settings
methods.description: Allows user to modify CIG and QoS settings.

methods.name: central_create_cig
methods.description: Creates CIG and connects CIS channels as central.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point initializing Bluetooth, handling role selection, and running tests.
